text: Based on the Earth-observation evidence, we can confirm that the forest has remained largely intact since 2020. The data shows that there was no detectable tree-cover loss of 0.5 hectares or more within the asset between 2021 and 2025. The asset had 285.6 hectares of forest in 2020, which was 91.77% of its total area. While minor changes under 0.5 hectares may not be detected, the overall forest cover has been stable.
